turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided on Owen's zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to him first?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect Owen's zero to be withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and your confirmation that nothing about this is on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She was still at her opening position and agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record, while the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and the meeting ended before you said anything.
What moved her: Nothing, because you ended the meeting before your first turn.
What cost ground: Nothing, because you made no moves before ending it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none, and the window proves nothing about the essay, though it is why she fights so hard.
Try next time: When she opens by asking who decided on the zero and whether Owen was heard, take ownership in one sentence that the zero went in before you called home, then show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself.
The meeting is over. To practise again, start a new chat and paste the first message from the README.
